---
name: Feature request
about: A question it should answer, or something it should do, that it does not today
title: "feature: <the question or capability, in one line>"
labels: enhancement
---

**The question you want answered**
<!-- In the words you would type to your AI assistant, e.g. "which flows send email when a Case closes?" -->

**What happens today**
<!-- The closest answer it gives, or the honest gap it reports. If it refused, paste the refusal (names scrubbed). -->

**Where the answer lives in Salesforce**
<!-- Which metadata holds it (Flow, Apex, profiles, layouts, reports...), or whether it needs live org data (record counts, user assignments). sf-intelligence is read-only and offline by default, so write actions are out of scope. -->

**Who needs this**
<!-- Admin, developer, architect, release manager; how often it comes up. -->

**Checklist**
- [ ] No real org, object, field, class, profile or user names in this issue
- [ ] I checked `sfi.list_analyses` (or asked "what can you do?") for an existing analysis
